title: 1.3 Related Fields to Physics
description: Related Fields to Physics concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A research group combines chemistry, engineering and geology in one project. What common foundation does the textbook identify?
options: All three are branches of biology
All three depend on medical imaging
All three study only the Earths surface

questions.question: A student claims biophysics and medical physics are identical. Which distinction from the textbook is most useful?
options: Biophysics studies biological phenomena; medical physics serves diagnosis and therapy
Biophysics studies rocks; medical physics studies stars in this topic in the textbook
Biophysics is a branch of history here in the textbook of this subject in experiments
Medical physics studies only sound now in the textbook of this subject in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Biophysics studies biological phenomena; medical physics serves diagnosis and therapy

questions.question: An architect must address structural stability, building acoustics and cooling loads. Which field integrates all three concerns?
A geologist uses radioactive dating on a rock and seismology on an earthquake. Which two physics-based methods are being used?
A hospital buys an MRI scanner and an ultrasound device. Which two branches of physics supply their operating principles?
A physicist models a bird wing using fluid motion and then studies the same principles in a wind tunnel. Which field is closest?
A scientist investigates how earthquake waves reveal the Earths interior and how heat moves through it. Which pair of fields is involved?
A student says chemistry has no link to physics. Which evidence from the textbook is strongest?
options: Chemistry is rooted in atomic and molecular physics
Chemists use only balances in class in the textbook
Chemistry is older than physics now in the textbook
Chemists study only plant matter now in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Chemistry is rooted in atomic and molecular physics

questions.question: A team develops a new imaging method for diagnosis and a method to map underground layers. Which two fields are represented?
options: Engineering and optics in the unit

questions.question: Which scenario illustrates engineering using physics for quality control and standards?
options: Testing the stability and dimensions of manufactured parts
Classifying living organisms in this topic in the textbook
Writing legal regulations now for students in the textbook
Composing music for a hall in the textbook of this subject
questions.correctAnswer: Testing the stability and dimensions of manufactured parts

questions.question: A researcher examines a cell using physical laws, while a colleague plans radiation therapy. Which pair of fields fits?
Which statement about the relationship between physics and geology is accurate?
options: Geology uses physics for radioactive dating, earthquakes and heat transfer
Geology studies only the naming of rocks now in this topic in the textbook
Geology and physics have no common methods in the textbook of this subject
Geology relies on biological classification alone in class in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Geology uses physics for radioactive dating, earthquakes and heat transfer

questions.question: A physicist works on the physics of hearing and another on the physics of light in buildings. Which fields are being applied?
options: Geophysics and biophysics now in the textbook in experiments
Medical physics and nuclear physics in class in the textbook
Chemistry and geology as well in the textbook in experiments

questions.question: Which example shows medical physics rather than general engineering?
options: Using ultrasonic blood flow measurements in a clinic
Designing a roof truss in this topic in the textbook
Planning a buildings ventilation now in the textbook
Choosing construction materials here in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Using ultrasonic blood flow measurements in a clinic

questions.question: A project uses physics to understand how a protein folds and how a tumor responds to radiation. Which fields are involved?
Which textbook statement explains why physics is called a foundation of many disciplines?
options: Its principles are applied across chemistry, engineering, geology and medicine
It is the oldest subject taught in schools now in the textbook of this subject
It uses the simplest instruments in this topic in the textbook of this subject
It avoids mathematical description for students in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Its principles are applied across chemistry, engineering, geology and medicine

questions.question: A geophysicist and a biophysicist share a method. What is the most likely shared element?
options: Applying physical principles to a specific natural system
Using only chemical reactions for students in experiments
Studying only human-made devices in class in the textbook
Working only with light microscopes still in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Applying physical principles to a specific natural system

questions.question: A student lists geology, geophysics and engineering as physics-related fields. Which justification is strongest?
options: Each applies physical principles to natural or built systems
Each studies only living things for students in the textbook
Each uses only statistics now in the textbook in experiments
Each is a branch of medicine in the textbook of this subject
questions.correctAnswer: Each applies physical principles to natural or built systems

questions.question: A hospital physics team checks an x-ray unit and a scanner. Which supporting field supplies the underlying principles?
A scientist explains the stability of an ancient building using forces and then dates its stones using radioactivity. Which two fields are combined?
